project_goal: Provide outsider-usable diagnostics and portable reliability/control-plane regressions derived from real multi-agent operational incidents, while keeping the broader historical architecture as reference material rather than presenting another production-ready agent framework.
current_portable_proven_components: lease/session independence with monotonic fencing epoch reference behavior
one-live-commit deployment primitive with CAS/evidence binding/rollback-once/failed-candidate replay denial
maturity_boundary: The public LeaseRegistry is an in-memory reference implementation of ownership/fencing semantics and must not be presented as a complete durable persistent workflow runtime.
lineage: GPT advisory role with human relay
included_domains: Agent Reliability Doctor source, fixture and regression tests
excluded_from_publication: private deployment paths or account-bound command examples
truth_rule: Historical claims remain evidence with explicit maturity. UNKNOWN is not PASS. Reference/scaffold code must not be described as live production acceptance, and GitHub stars or internal tests do not constitute external market validation.

release_candidate.wheel_license_scope: Apache-2.0 software; narrative CC docs not bundled in wheel
release_candidate.sdist_license_scope: Apache-2.0 software + CC-BY-4.0 narrative docs with both canonical license texts
release_candidate.current_main_packaging: visual Doctor demo + use-case triage + integration guide + sample audit report + service assurance + commercial services + public no-secret fit-check + GitHub Pages sales surface

publish_gate: portable clean Python 3.11 install + CLI smoke PASS
